# Contributing to Limes

Contributions are welcome.

## Bug reports and feature requests

Use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/TyrusRC/limes/issues/new). Search existing issues
first, describe what happened, and include verbose error output and your environment.
Security issues must be reported privately; see SECURITY.md.

## Pull requests

1. Fork https://github.com/TyrusRC/limes and clone your fork.
2. Create a branch for your change and keep commits small and focused.
3. Run the test suite (`make test`) before opening a PR.
4. Open a pull request against `main` describing the why of the change.
